shared_elements: repeated short vertical strokes along a horizontal line
long horizontal or curving linear forms
small isolated marks or short bars
justification: The most specific correspondence is the use of comb-like rows of short vertical strokes attached to horizontal linear elements, visible on the boat-like forms in A and in the patterned band across B. The biggest difference is that A is a dispersed red painted linear composition on a broad sloping rock face, while B is a compact carved relief organized into stacked, framed areas with larger animal-like figures.
